title: A Aftermath for the Weather
author: Silas Underhill
blurb: Dominic Okonkwo, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, has spent seven years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
